reports.title: Akhona Moyo: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Hospital doctors, including in the Emergency Department and Paediatrics, do not have electronic access to primary care medical notes e.g. GP notes, community mental health notes etc.
concerns.hazard: lack of electronic access to primary care medical notes

concerns.quote: Access may also enable doctors to have a more global view of a patient's medical condition rather than, as it was put at Inquest, "working in silos"
All the doctors that gave evidence to the Inquest stated that access to primary care records would undoubtedly assist them in delivering better patient treatment and care
concerns.hazard: absence of primary care record access

concerns.quote: It was felt that access to such information was particularly important in cases such as the present when a patient is autistic and non-verbal
concerns.hazard: inadequate information for autistic non-verbal patients

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that hospital doctors, including those in Emergency Departments, cannot access patients' GP or primary care notes. This lack of access is described as a safety gap that could lead to avoidable harm.
